column1: # The expected verdict of each Arena "either" test for the v4.37 profile (spec 05.2 and 11.3.3).

# The verdict is the verdict of `leanchecker --from-export` of Lean v4.37.0-rc1 on the exports that scripts/arena-build.py makes with Lean v4.36.0 at the Arena commit of the results of 2026-11-21. The CI job `arena-either` runs that leanchecker on each test and requires the verdict of this file (scripts/arena-official.sh).
